disclaimer: Candidate locations chosen for exposure to the prevailing south-easterly swell and trade winds, using public coordinates. NONE of these is a surveyed or proposed development site. No bathymetric survey, seabed assessment, grid-connection study, environmental assessment or consultation underlies this list — it exists so a forecast resource figure has somewhere to be computed.
coverage_note: All candidate points are NEARSHORE (within a few km of the coast, mostly inside or just outside the reef). The deep-water wave-power formula used by this pillar overestimates in shallow water, so figures here are indicative only and not comparable with published deep-water resource atlases.

sites.name: South-east coast, offshore of Mahebourg
sites.exposure: Directly exposed to the prevailing south-easterly swell and trade winds — the most energetic side of the island.

sites.name: South coast, offshore of Souillac
sites.exposure: Open southern exposure with little reef shelter; receives long-period Southern Ocean swell.

sites.name: East coast, offshore of Belle Mare
sites.exposure: Windward east coast; consistent trade-wind forcing, moderate swell.

sites.name: Northern channel, off Cap Malheureux
sites.exposure: Channel between Mauritius and the northern islets; wind funnelling, weaker swell than the south-east.

sites.name: West coast, offshore of Flic-en-Flac
sites.exposure: Leeward coast, sheltered by the island from the dominant south-easterly. Included as a low-resource reference point.
